comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: This might be the most wholesome law in the world: It is illegal to own just one guinea pig because they get... lonely and depressed, and there is even a "companion rental" service for them! A nation strict enough that trains are never more than 3 minutes late, yet filled with deeply humane laws. Switzerland is truly on another level! 🐹🕰

comments.author: @ChinaPrideStudio
comments.text:
American presenters often make this serious mistake, which is a disgrace. Learn to pronounce other people's names correctly; this is the basic courtesy and minimum requirement of any international production.
Jungfrau is German. Jung means young; frau means virgin girl. The beautiful name means Young virgin mountain.
Pronouncing the word as Jone-frau is unforgivable sin, making it sound like Jones is foul, or frawning.
Do not repeat such silly mistakes in your future productions. Do some proper research first; this is the least respect you should show to Switzerland, or indeed any other European country with long tradition which is not America.
